name: UP1 Unit 1 — Interests, strengths and routines

entries.definitionEn: Making pictures with a pencil or colours.

entries.example: I usually read stories after school.
entries.notes: Interest form: I like reading stories.

entries.definitionEn: Playing a team game by kicking a ball.
entries.notes: Interest form: I like playing football.

entries.definitionEn: Making a small version of something, such as a house.
Finding the answers to a puzzle or problem.
entries.example: I am good at solving puzzles.

entries.definitionEn: Doing something useful for a friend.
entries.notes: Routine form: I help a friend.

entries.definitionEn: Being able to do an activity well.
entries.example: I am good at drawing pictures.
entries.notes: Teach as a chunk: be good at + activity-ing. Do not rank classmates.

entries.definitionEn: Every time in the situation being described.
entries.notes: Introduce in grammar L4; position before the action verb in these models.

entries.definitionEn: Most times in the situation being described.
entries.notes: Introduce in grammar L4; no fixed percentage is required.

entries.definitionEn: Many times in the situation being described.
entries.notes: Introduce in grammar L4; distinguish many times from every time.

entries.definitionEn: On some occasions, but not every time.
Not at any time in the situation being described.
entries.example: I never play football before school.
entries.notes: Introduce in grammar L4; I never play, not I do not never play.
